svg.text: N
NEIGHBORHOOD
Streets, rows and lots, as the level is built
Naming a house
Row, then lot: “Rumbo north lot 4” is RN 4.
Lots count the houses along their row.
The heavy edge of a house is its front.
Rows
RN Rumbo north row, lots 1 to 9
RS Rumbo south row, lots 1 to 8
GN Gaviota north row, lots 1 to 7
NW Neblina west row, lots 1 to 6
GS Gaviota south row, lots 1 to 7
Designs (under each lot)
S, M, L small, medium, large plan
Sp Spanish
Cr Craftsman
Mo Monterey
Roofs are drawn in their tile's colour.
Marks
